headline: Seven years of evidence, now searchable
body: Every game any of you has ever played is now on a website, sorted and permanently public. You can no longer claim you were robbed in 2021. The math is right there and it says you scored 96 points.

The big one: Cody, Ryan and Austin have each played seven seasons and each finished 51-45. Same record, same seven years, zero championships between them. Bo is 42-41 with two rings. Somewhere in there is a lesson about the value of trying hard and it is not a flattering one.
Pick your name from the dropdown to see your own file. Rule vote closes at the draft.

changed.note: Two rings in three years. Insufferable and technically entitled to it.
Best season in league history, 1,803 points in 2021. Finished fourth.
Leads all-time in points scored and points allowed. Not bad at this, just hunted.
Champion to last place in one calendar year. A speedrun.
Runner-up in 2023, then 7-7, 6-8, 5-9. Trending like a stock nobody should buy.
